layers.title: Shared contracts
layers.description: The formats and interfaces several components agree on: ECMA-335 IL and metadata, the managed type system, the JIT/EE interface, ReadyToRun, the host/runtime contract, the diagnostics protocols and data contracts, Webcil.

layers.title: Runtimes

layers.title: Code generators and IL tools
layers.description: What turns IL into machine code or a smaller IL: RyuJIT, crossgen2, ILC, Mono mini/LLVM/interpreter, ILLink.

layers.title: Libraries
layers.description: System.Private.CoreLib, the BCL areas, the interop source generators and the native shims under them.

layers.title: Host
layers.description: dotnet / apphost / hostfxr / hostpolicy and the entry hosts that find a framework and start a runtime.

layers.title: Build and test infrastructure
layers.description: The repo-wide build (Arcade, subsets, CMake configuration), platform abstraction and the test trees.

components.title: IL, metadata and the PE file (ECMA-335 and its addenda)
components.one_line: The CLI specification every runtime, compiler and reader agrees on: IL, metadata tables, signatures, the PE/COFF image, the memory model, and this repo's addenda (DIMs, covariant returns, byref-like generics, runtime async).
evidence: src/libraries/System.Reflection.Metadata (managed reader used by the AOT tools: src/coreclr/tools/Common/TypeSystem/Ecma/EcmaModule.cs:7)
docs/design/specs/Ecma-335-Augments.md is the normative addendum the type loader docs point to

components.title: Managed type system (ILCompiler.TypeSystem)
components.one_line: The compile-time model of types, methods, layout, casting and generics in C#, built over System.Reflection.Metadata; shared source for every managed compiler and verifier, and linked into the Native AOT runtime type loader.
evidence: linked as source into src/coreclr/tools/aot/ILCompiler.Compiler, ILCompiler.ReadyToRun, ILCompiler.RyuJit, src/coreclr/tools/dotnet-pgo/dotnet-pgo.csproj, src/coreclr/tools/ILVerification/ILVerification.projitems, src/coreclr/tools/ILTrim.Core

components.title: JIT/EE interface (ICorJitInfo / ICorJitCompiler) and GC info
components.one_line: The single interface between a code generator and whatever hosts it, generated from one thunk list into the VM, the AOT compilers' C# CorInfoImpl and SuperPMI; versioned by one GUID. Includes the GC info encoding (src/coreclr/gcinfo) the JIT writes and the VM, Native AOT and cDAC decode.
evidence: src/coreclr/tools/Common/JitInterface/ThunkGenerator/gen.sh:3 generates CorInfoImpl_generated.cs, aot/jitinterface/jitinterface_generated.h, jit/ICorJitInfo_*_generated, inc/icorjitinfoimpl_generated.h and superpmi-shim-{counter,simple}/icorjitinfo_generated.cpp from ThunkInput.txt
src/coreclr/vm/jitinterface.cpp (CEEInfo, the VM side); src/coreclr/vm/codeman.cpp:2000 getJit()
src/coreclr/interpreter/eeinterp.cpp, compiler.cpp use ICorJitInfo (the CoreCLR interpreter is a JIT-shaped client)
src/coreclr/tools/superpmi (records and replays this interface to test the JIT)

src/coreclr/gcinfo built into jit (jit/CMakeLists.txt) and vm (vm/CMakeLists.txt:863 gcinfodecoder.cpp); src/coreclr/nativeaot/Runtime/gcinfodecoder.cpp; docs/design/datacontracts/GCInfo.md (cDAC decoder)

components.title: ReadyToRun image format
components.one_line: The precompiled-code format crossgen2 writes and the CoreCLR VM loads (fixups, import sections, composite images, the PerfMap and native envelope); versioned in readytorun.h and also read by R2RDump and the cDAC.

components.title: Data contracts and the cDAC
components.one_line: Versioned descriptions of runtime data structures that each runtime publishes as a data descriptor, and the managed reader (cDAC) that implements the SOS/DAC COM surface over them so diagnostic tools need no version-matched DAC.
evidence: src/coreclr/gc/datadescriptor and src/coreclr/gc/CMakeLists.txt (the GC publishes its own descriptor)

components.title: EventPipe and the diagnostic server (IPC protocol)
components.one_line: Runtime-agnostic C implementation of EventPipe tracing and the diagnostics IPC protocol (dump, process, profiler, eventpipe commands) compiled into CoreCLR, Native AOT and Mono, each through its own shim.
evidence: src/native/eventpipe/ds-protocol.c, ds-eventpipe-protocol.c, ds-dump-protocol.c, ds-profiler-protocol.c, ds-ipc-pal-socket.c, ds-ipc-pal-websocket.c

components.title: Profiling API (ICorProfilerInfo / ICorProfilerCallback)
components.one_line: The COM-style in-process profiler interface CoreCLR exposes: callbacks, ELT hooks, attach/detach, ReJIT and IL rewriting. CoreCLR only; Mono has its own unrelated profiler API.

components.title: Host/runtime contract
components.one_line: How a host hands a runtime its configuration: the coreclr_initialize / monovm entry points, the property bag (TPA, probing paths, STARTUP_HOOKS) and host_runtime_contract callbacks. Both CoreCLR and Mono implement it.

components.title: Webcil assembly format
components.one_line: A WebAssembly-module wrapper for IL assemblies so they survive hosting environments that block DLLs; written by the WebAssembly build tasks and by crossgen2, read by both Mono and the CoreCLR VM.

components.title: CoreCLR VM (execution engine core)
components.one_line: The native runtime: startup and hosting entry, the AppDomain and module model, CoreLib's FCalls/QCalls, the code manager, allocation helpers and the frozen (NonGC) heap; the subsystems below are its parts.
evidence: src/coreclr/vm (522 entries); built into libcoreclr by src/coreclr/dlls/mscoree/coreclr/CMakeLists.txt
src/coreclr/vm/ecalllist.h, qcallentrypoints.cpp (CoreLib's entry points into the VM)
src/coreclr/vm/gcenv.ee.cpp (GC-to-EE side of the GC interface)
src/coreclr/vm/corelib.h, binder.cpp (the VM names CoreLib types and methods it binds to)

components.title: Type loader and runtime type system
components.one_line: Builds MethodTables, EEClasses and MethodDescs from metadata at run time: layout, generics and shared generic dictionaries, interface and DIM resolution, covariant returns, byref-like and inline arrays, UnsafeAccessor.

components.title: Stubs and dispatch
components.one_line: Virtual stub dispatch, precode and fixup stubs, jump stubs and the tailcall-via-helpers machinery.

components.title: Exception handling and stack walking
components.one_line: Managed exception dispatch (two-pass, funclets), stack walking, the native unwinder and CET shadow-stack support.
evidence: src/coreclr/unwinder (also built into the DAC: dlls/mscordac/CMakeLists.txt, and into Native AOT: nativeaot/Runtime/CMakeLists.txt)

components.title: Threading and suspension
components.one_line: Managed threads, the runtime suspension (cooperative/preemptive modes, hijacking), sync blocks and monitors.

components.title: Interop: P/Invoke, COM and the type map
components.one_line: Runtime marshalling and IL stubs for P/Invoke, built-in COM, ComWrappers, IJW/mixed-mode assemblies and the interop type map.

components.title: Code versioning, tiering, OSR and PGO
components.one_line: Which native code body a method runs: tiered compilation, code versions and ReJIT, on-stack replacement transitions and the runtime half of dynamic PGO.

components.title: Assembly binder and AssemblyLoadContext
components.one_line: Resolves assembly references to files through the TPA list and AssemblyLoadContexts, including contextual reflection and collectible (unloadable) contexts.

components.title: Debugger, DAC and dump generation
components.one_line: The managed debugging stack (DBI right side, in-process left side), the native DAC that reads runtime state out of process, and createdump for cross-platform minidumps.
evidence: src/coreclr/dlls/mscordac, mscordbi (built from VM sources with DACCESS_COMPILE)

components.title: CoreCLR interpreter
components.one_line: An IL interpreter for CoreCLR that compiles IL to its own bytecode through the JIT/EE interface; the execution strategy for targets with no JIT such as WebAssembly.

components.title: Garbage collector
components.one_line: The generational mark/sweep/compact collector with regions, background GC, the handle table and the GC/EE interface; compiled into CoreCLR, loadable standalone (libclrgc), and compiled into the Native AOT runtime. Not used by Mono, which has SGen.
evidence: src/coreclr/vm/gchelpers.cpp (allocation sampling lives on the VM side)

components.title: Native AOT runtime
components.one_line: The minimal runtime linked into Native AOT executables: Runtime (C++: GC host, stack walking, thread suspension), its own CoreLib layer, the runtime type loader and reflection execution.

components.title: Mono runtime
components.one_line: The Mono VM used for mobile and WebAssembly: metadata loader, SGen GC, cooperative suspend, components (debugger agent, hot reload, EventPipe, marshal-ilgen), the soft debugger and its wire protocol, and library mode.
evidence: src/mono/mono/component/debugger-agent.c, debugger-protocol.c (soft debugger and wire format)

components.title: WebAssembly browser host and debugger proxy
components.one_line: The JavaScript/TypeScript runtime host for .NET in the browser (and the WASI host beside it), the browser debug proxy that bridges Chrome DevTools to the Mono soft debugger, and ICU loading for wasm.

components.title: RyuJIT
components.one_line: The optimizing compiler from IL to native code: importer, morph, SSA/VN optimizations, LSRA, codegen and emitters per architecture; used as the JIT by CoreCLR and as the backend of crossgen2 and ILC, and loaded by SuperPMI for replay.
docs: docs/design/coreclr/jit/Optimization of Heap Access in Value Numbering.md

components.title: ILC (Native AOT compiler)
components.one_line: The whole-program compiler that scans the dependency graph from Main, compiles with RyuJIT, generates metadata and writes an object file linked with the Native AOT runtime; shares its trim analysis with ILLink.

components.title: crossgen2 (ReadyToRun compiler) and dotnet-pgo
components.one_line: Compiles assemblies (or composite images) to ReadyToRun with RyuJIT, version-resilient within the R2R rules; consumes .mibc profiles from dotnet-pgo (src/coreclr/tools/dotnet-pgo).
evidence: src/coreclr/crossgen-corelib.proj (CoreLib is crossgen'd in the build)

components.title: Mono mini: JIT, AOT and LLVM backend
components.one_line: Mono's code generator: linear IR, register allocation, trampolines, exception handling, the AOT compiler (including full-AOT, profiled AOT and WebAssembly AOT) and the LLVM backend.

components.title: Mono interpreter and the jiterpreter
components.one_line: The IL interpreter Mono uses on WebAssembly and iOS, with the jiterpreter that compiles hot interpreter traces to WebAssembly at run time.

components.title: ILLink (the trimmer)
components.one_line: Removes unused IL from an app with Mono.Cecil, driven by reflection-flow annotations; ships with an MSBuild task and a Roslyn analyzer that report the same trim warnings.

components.title: Shared trim analysis (ILLink.Shared)
components.one_line: The trim/AOT dataflow and warning logic (DynamicallyAccessedMembers, RequiresUnreferencedCode, feature checks) compiled as source into ILLink, its Roslyn analyzer, ILC, crossgen2 and ILTrim so all of them warn alike.

components.title: System.Private.CoreLib (shared source)
components.one_line: The one source tree for the core library, imported by three runtime-specific CoreLib projects (CoreCLR, Native AOT, Mono) that add their runtime glue: primitives, strings, globalization, threading, tasks, EventSource/EventCounters, startup hooks.

components.title: Interop source generators (LibraryImport, GeneratedComInterface)
components.one_line: Roslyn generators that emit P/Invoke and COM marshalling code at compile time instead of runtime IL stubs; used by most libraries through eng/generators.targets.
evidence: eng/generators.targets:3 enables LibraryImportGenerator for library builds

components.title: Common interop declarations (src/libraries/Common)
components.one_line: Interop.*.cs P/Invoke declarations and helpers compiled as source into each library that needs them (94 project files, 332 includes in CoreLib alone) rather than shared through an assembly.

components.title: Native shims (System.Native and friends)
components.one_line: The thin C libraries the managed libraries P/Invoke into on Unix-like systems: System.Native, System.Globalization.Native (ICU), System.Security.Cryptography.Native (OpenSSL, Apple, Android), System.Net.Security.Native, compression; statically linked into CoreCLR single-file, Native AOT and the WebAssembly runtimes.

components.title: Globalization
components.one_line: Culture data, comparison and casing over ICU, NLS or platform-native APIs (hybrid mode on Apple), plus invariant mode; mostly in CoreLib with System.Globalization.Native beneath it.

components.title: Networking (System.Net.*)
components.one_line: Sockets, HTTP (SocketsHttpHandler, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3), QUIC, TLS, WebSockets and name resolution.

components.title: IO (System.IO.*)
components.one_line: Files, streams, pipes, compression, memory-mapped files and the file system watcher; FileStream itself lives in CoreLib.

components.title: Collections and primitives
components.one_line: Generic and concurrent collections, immutable collections, hashing (Dictionary, HashCode, randomized string hashing) and numeric primitives.

components.title: Reflection and metadata (System.Reflection.*)
components.one_line: System.Reflection.Metadata (the managed ECMA-335 and Portable PDB reader/writer), MetadataLoadContext, Emit and DispatchProxy; the reader is also the foundation of the AOT tools' type system.

components.title: Cryptography (System.Security.Cryptography)
components.one_line: Hashing, symmetric and asymmetric algorithms, X.509 and PKCS, layered over OpenSSL, CNG, Apple Security and Android through native shims.

components.title: hostfxr and the dotnet muxer
components.one_line: Reads runtimeconfig.json, resolves the framework set and SDK (roll-forward, version rules) and exposes the hosting APIs; the dotnet executable is a thin muxer over it.

components.title: hostpolicy
components.one_line: Reads .deps.json, probes for assemblies and native libraries, builds the TPA and runtime properties and starts the runtime through the host/runtime contract.

components.title: apphost, single-file and the entry hosts
components.one_line: The app-specific executable (apphost and the single-file bundle host), plus nethost, comhost and ijwhost, which locate hostfxr; Microsoft.NET.HostModel stamps and bundles them.
evidence: src/native/corehost/apphost, bundle, nethost, comhost, ijwhost, fxr_resolver.c

components.title: Build and test infrastructure
components.one_line: Arcade-based build: subsets (clr, mono, libs, host, packs), the CMake toolchain configuration for every native component, generators wiring, the runtime test tree (src/tests) and CI.

components.title: minipal (minimal platform layer)
components.one_line: Small C platform helpers (CPU features, random, time, mutex) compiled into every native component, replacing pieces of the older CoreCLR PAL; the PAL itself (src/coreclr/pal) is folded here.
evidence: referenced by src/coreclr/{jit,gc,interpreter,vm via dlls/mscoree}/CMakeLists.txt, src/mono/mono/CMakeLists.txt, src/native/corehost/CMakeLists.txt, src/native/libs/CMakeLists.txt
src/coreclr/pal (Windows API emulation for CoreCLR on Unix)
